name: icon.io
description: Repo-level tooling. The two applications live in back/ and front/ and keep their own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix back ci && npm --prefix front ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix back run typecheck && npm --prefix front run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix back test && npm --prefix front test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
